flashcard_questions.q: The absence of conflict and violence; a state of harmony between people or nations.
One of the 99 names of Allah, meaning 'the source of peace'.
Fairness and the upholding of what is morally right, including the fair treatment of all people.

flashcard_questions.a: Pardoning someone for what they have done wrong and letting go of anger or desire for revenge.
The restoration of harmony between people or groups who have been in conflict.
